placements.why: Both segments perform the establishment of instrument calibration as a settled organizational fact — the content names an organizational category for calibration work that nothing existing covers.
placements.title: From raw instrument readings to verified measurement
placements.frame: How is instrument calibration established, verified, and maintained as settled?

placements.title: From calibration claim to verified measurement standard
placements.frame: How does an instrument's calibration become a settled, verified fact rather than an untested assertion?
placements.why: Both expressions establish the same calibration state through complementary acts — src-1 verifies against June reference plates and confirms it holds across the observing band, src-2 ratifies the same fact as a decision of record — accumulating as the theme of how calibration becomes settled through verification and ratification.
